script.opening_words:
The sticky note is still on your fridge.
7515 1510 under a magnet from a pizza
place that closed. You wrote it in
January and you meant it the way people
mean gym memberships in January. Two
people you will never meet wrote those
same numbers on their own fridges that
week. Same take-home, 4,100 a month
after taxes. Desmond hit those
percentages six months straight. He'd
check the note every payday like a man
saying grace. Then his transmission went
and by month 8 he had sold every share
he owne
script.ending_words:
ver
once ask how you are feeling about it
today. Renee did not beat Desmond
because she wanted it more. She made one
decision once. He made the same decision
30 times and eventually lost one. That
is the difference between them and it is
probably the difference for you. The
number on your fridge was never the
system. The system is whether your money
moves before you get a chance to have an
opinion about it. Go set the transfer,
then go put something better on the
fridge. And if you want the worked
spreadsheets behind every number in this
video, they are waiting for you in our
school community.
